articles.summary: BANNOCKBURN, Ill., June 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Option Care Health, Inc. (NASDAQ: OPCH), the nation’s largest independent provider of home and alternate site infusion services, announced the appointment of Robert Okunski as Vice President, Investor Relations effective May 26, 2026.
articles.title: Option Care Health Appoints Robert Okunski as Vice President, Investor Relations

articles.summary: BANNOCKBURN, Ill., June 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Option Care Health is proud to announce it has been ranked No. 15 on the World’s Most Impactful Companies 2026 list, a global recognition of organizations delivering measurable positive impact across society, the environment, and the economy.
articles.title: Option Care Health Awarded TIME's World's Most Impactful Companies 2026 Ranking
